grants.description: Verify your identity using your passport and visa details
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity and link your collection request to your visa record

grants.description: Check your visa and immigration status with Home Office records
grants.purpose: To verify you are eligible to collect a BRP and that your visa details match

grants.description: Confirm the biometric data (photo and fingerprints) previously captured will be used on your BRP
grants.purpose: Your biometric data will be printed on the BRP card for identity verification

grants.description: Provide your arrival date and confirm the post office collection location
grants.purpose: To send you collection authorization and reminders about collecting your BRP within 10 days

revocation.mechanism: Contact the Home Office or revoke through your UKVI account
revocation.effect: Collection authorization will be cancelled. You will need to contact the Home Office to arrange alternative collection.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot collect the BRP on your behalf - you must attend the post office in person. Agent cannot change your biometric data. Agent cannot extend the 10-day collection deadline.
